cohort: The study included 66 parturients who underwent post-spinal caesarean section.
finding: Local infiltration with Bupivacaine (0.25%) provided rapid and longer post-operative analgesia with fewer rescue analgesic requirements and better quality of analgesia compared to intravenous Paracetamol (1G 8th hourly), making it a highly cost-effective technique.
followup_time: Up to 8 hours post-surgery for primary observations
